items.component_name: Construction of rural godowns (100 MT to 30,000 MT; 50 MT for hill areas)
items.benefit: Subsidy on capital cost: 25% for all farmers; 33.33% for women farmers, SHGs, cooperatives, entrepreneurs; 15% for other categories
items.eligibility: Farmers, women farmers, SHGs, cooperatives and entrepreneurs as per scheme norms
items.how_to_apply: Apply through District Agriculture Marketing Office / concerned implementing agency

items.scheme_name: Scheme for Development / Strengthening of Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure, Grading & Standardization
items.benefit: 25% subsidy on capital cost up to Rs 50 lakh per project; 33.33% subsidy up to Rs 60 lakh for hilly/tribal areas or SC/ST entrepreneurs and cooperatives; No ceiling for projects of State agencies
items.eligibility: State agencies, cooperatives, farmers, entrepreneurs, including those in hilly/tribal areas and SC/ST categories
items.how_to_apply: Apply through District Agriculture Marketing Office / State implementing agency

items.scheme_name: Initiative for Nutritional Security through Intensive Millets Promotion (INSIMP)
items.component_name: Awareness programmes and food festivals (district level)
items.benefit: Rs 1 lakh per food festival per district
items.how_to_apply: Apply through District Agriculture Office under INSIMP
